description: This file defines an Angular component 'NoteEditorComponent' used for editing individual notes in a note-taking application. It handles loading a note, debounced auto-saving on changes, and emits save events.

classes.name: NoteEditorComponent
classes.description: An Angular component for editing notes with auto-save functionality, listening for changes to a specific note, and emitting save events.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles input property changes, triggers note loading when 'noteId' changes.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the note from the NotesService based on the current 'noteId'.

methods.name: onTitleChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the note's title, triggers a save.

methods.name: onContentChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the note's content, triggers a save.

methods.name: triggerSave
methods.description: Debounced method that saves the current note state using NotesService and emits a save event.

methods.name: function debounce<T extends (...args: any[]) => void>(fn: T, ms = 400): T { debounce

ctags.name: debounce
ctags.pattern: /^function debounce<T extends (...args: any[]) => void>(fn: T, ms = 400): T {$/
